section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Theft Deterrent System
title: INSPECTION OF SOURCE CIRCUIT

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for theft deterrent system source circuit inspection. Starts with turning ignition switch on, then checks DOME fuse, C/G fuse, and proceeds through various ground connection and switch operation tests for back door and key switches.

steps.no: Replace fuse. Is operation normal? → If No: Short circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 5 of computer. If Yes: Fuse faulty

steps.yes: Continue to BACK DOOR S/W section
steps.no: Replace fuse. Is operation normal? → If No: Short circuit in wire harness between fuse and terminal 4 of computer. If Yes: Fuse faulty

steps.text:
INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
Is there continuity between back door switch body and body ground?

INSPECT BACK DOOR SWITCH OPERATION
Is there continuity between terminal 1 and body ground with back door switch turned on?
steps.yes: Continue to BACK DOOR KEY S/W section

steps.text:
INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
Is there continuity between terminal 3 and body ground?
steps.no:
• Open circuit in wire harness between terminal 3 and body ground.
• Body ground faulty.
